Name: Page Fault
Description: Memory could not be accessed (out of bounds, or forbidden)

Name: Invalid Instruction
Description: Instruction opcode or arguments were invalid

Name: Receive Input
Args: r1 - device id, r2 - input type, r3 - value

Name: Get Display Buf Start
Description: Returns the start address of the display buffer in r0

Name: Get Uptime MSEC
Description: Returns the uptime in milliseconds in r0

Name: Refresh Screen
Description: Update the display with new data in the display buffer

Name: DEBUG: Print Number
Description: Prints a number with a \n, only possible in debug mode
